title: Venous plexus
summary: A venous plexus is a congregation of multiple veins.A list of venous plexuses:

Basilar plexus Batson venous plexus Internal vertebral venous plexuses Pterygoid plexus Submucosal venous plexus of the nose Uterine venous plexus Vaginal venous plexus Venous plexus of hypoglossal canal Vesical venous plexus Soleal venous plexus Pampiniform venous plexus Prostatic venous plexus Rectal venous plexus
